simple.meaning: בֵּית הַמַּרְכָּבוֹת (Bêyth ham-Markâbôwth) is a Hebrew word meaning “Beth-ham-Markaboth or Beth-Markaboth , a place in Palestine.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: בֵּית הַמַּרְכָּבוֹת (H1024) appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Joshua 19:5, with occurrences in Joshua, 1 Chronicles.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to בֵּית הַמַּרְכָּבוֹת (H1024) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in בֵּית הַמַּרְכָּבוֹת (H1024) before moving outward to related references.
